name: What is the difference between final detail work and punch list items?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between final detail work and punch list items?

acceptedAnswer.text: Final detail work refers to the last-stage refinements and finishing touches performed by the construction team to complete the project to a high standard, based on the original scope. Punch list items, conversely, are typically identified by the client or project manager during the final walkthrough as specific tasks that need correction, completion, or adjustment to meet expectations or contract specifications. While closely related, the punch list specifically addresses deficiencies, whereas detail work is part of the standard finishing process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Final detail work is the standard finishing touches, while punch list items are specific corrections or adjustments noted during client walkthroughs.
